flagged_sentences: In 2018 the House of Commons Environment, Food and Rural Affairs Committee examined hospital records and found admissions for dog bites had climbed from 4,110 in 2005 to 7,461 in 2017.
The RSPCA later reviewed thirty fatal dog attacks that occurred after the Act and found twenty-one involved dogs that were never on the prohibited list.
